t: This is Penton Rise, a street in Islington. It takes its name from Henry Penton, who lived from 1736 to 1812. He was a politician who sat in the House of Commons for thirty-five years, from 1761 to 1796, and was a Lord of the Admiralty. Penton developed his estate in north London, and in doing so he became the founder of Pentonville. So the name here points back to the man behind the whole neighbourhood.
